book.name: 1 Jon
book.title: 1 JON JON PƗLƗWUTA KƗTA WAN PAS

content: KRAIST GODNA KIMBUK MAAWUK KAT KWUNATƗGANDƗ

Ngwuk wuna apma nyangu ngwuk. Kavle vat yilɨngwangat kai waa ngwuk kat wan nyaangɨt pɨlɨwutɨgowun. Ngwutna kɨta nyan kavle vat yindeyan nɨmamba ke yelavɨka lɨlɨngweya. Nɨn kat tɨga God kat ngambulɨga nyan Jisas Kraist ngilɨga. Ndɨ apma vat mɨna yiga yetɨliga nyana.
Ndɨ nɨna kavle vak kat wenga kwiga Godna kimbuk maawut kwunatndɨ. Nɨna kavle vak kat mɨna ana kwunatndɨ. Kɨpmamba ngepma ngepmamba lɨga nɨmbana kavle vak kat aywaa kwunatndɨ.
Kɨta nyan Godna sɨ wuka ndɨna mɨndama vɨga tɨnda vak anda vapmba vɨgiyadɨ. Wupma vɨgiyandɨ. God waa nyaangɨtmba yetɨgiyaa nyan ndɨ Godna sɨ wuka ndɨna mɨndama vɨga lɨga nyana.
Godna sɨ wuka ndɨna mɨndama vɨga lɨgowun waa kɨta nyan walaa God waa nyaangɨt kat kai wandeyan wan nyan woseka walɨga nyana. Woseka walɨnja vapmba walɨgandɨ.
Kɨta nyan God waa vapmba yetɨndeya ndɨ God kat apma vapmba woviyaguga lɨndɨ. God waa vapmba yetɨndeyan ndɨ Godnonala kɨta vat tɨndangat vɨgiyandɨ.
Kɨta nya Godnonala kɨta vapmba yetɨgowun waa walaa Jisas yeta vap vla yetɨndeyan nglaatndɨ.
KUPI NYAANGƗTNA
Wuna apma nɨmbangwuk kat kapma vat tɨga nyaangɨt ana pɨlɨwutɨgowun. Tamba la nyaangɨtna pɨlɨwutɨwa. Tak wan nyaangɨt wukngwuk.

Ngwuk kat nat samat kupi nyaangɨtna pɨlɨwupmak yiwa. Wan kupi nyaangɨtmba yetɨga tat Jisas yalaa ngwuk kat apma vat yindɨ. Apma vat yinda vat kulun waa kavamba lɨga kembanda vak vla lɨgandɨ. Nɨn kat kulun wala la kavle vat tamba ngɨlɨvat yigandɨ. Apma vat tamba yandɨ.
Kɨta nyan ndɨna kɨta mbaapma nyan kat kai walɨndeyan ndɨ kulun waa kavamba yetɨlɨga nyan vla lɨgandɨ. Wun apma vapmba yetɨlɨgowun waa wandeyan ndɨ woseka waigandɨ.

Kɨta nyan ndɨna kɨta mbaapma nyan kat kwunaka woviyaguga lɨndeyan ndɨ wan nyan kemba lɨga kavamba yetɨlɨga nyan vla lɨgandɨ. Ndɨ kavle vak ana yetɨlɨga nyana. Ndɨnai yetɨlɨga vak wan nat nɨmbana maawut ana kavle yigiyandɨ.

Kɨta nyan ndɨna kɨta mbaapma nyan kat kai walɨndeyan ndɨ kavle maawut yelavɨka yetɨlɨga nyana. Apma vat yindeya yambɨ kai. Mɨni kiya la yetɨlɨga nyan vla lɨgandɨ. Apma vat yiga yetɨndeya yambɨ kat ana vɨlɨgandɨ.

Ngwutna nat nɨmba mat nyangu vla lɨgangwuk. God Jisas kwutna njɨvwa vɨlaa ngwula kavle vat yilɨngwa vat yilɨngwa vat sɨlɨmbwindɨ. Gwuk God kat vɨga lɨgangwuk. Mbambala nglei ngwula maawupmba wan vak klangwuk. Ngwuk kat pɨlɨwutɨgowun. Ngwutna nat nɨmba nɨma nɨmba vla lɨgangwuk. Tamba la nyan God ndɨna sɨ wuka ndɨna mɨndama vɨga lɨgangwuk. Ngwutno ngwuk kat pɨlɨwutɨgowun. Ngwutna nat nɨmba kwandɨ nyangu vla lɨgangwuk. Ngwuk Seten kat kwulakngwuk. Ngwuk kwonduo lɨga nɨmba ngwuk. God waa nyaangɨt ngwula maawupmba lɨgandɨ.
Wan kɨpmamba lɨga vak kat nɨmamba ke yelavɨka yetɨga. Kɨta nyan wan kɨpmana vak kat nɨmamba yelavɨka yetɨndeyan God kat nɨmamba ana yelavɨk kiyandɨ.
Wan kɨpmana vat kɨngiyan. Kavle nda klavat walɨnja vat. Kavle vat vɨvat walɨnja vat. Wun nɨma nyan wun wun apma vat yetɨga nyan wun waawalɨnja vat. Wan vak God kwiya vak ana ndɨ. Kɨpmana vatna.
Kɨpmana vat ngɨni aywaa ngɨlɨga yiga kwo vatnat tɨgiyandɨ. Klavat walɨnja vat ngɨni ngɨlɨga yiga kwo vatnat tɨgiyandɨ. Kɨta nyan God waa vapmba yetɨndeyan wan nyan njɨmbla njɨmbla apma vat tɨgiyandɨ.
KRAIST KAT KAI WALƗGA NYANA

Wuna nyangu, kɨpmana vat ngɨlɨgiya njɨmbla tamba ngwaya. Kraist kat kai waiga nyana yaiga njɨmbla tamba ngwaya. Wupma wukngwuk. Mbamala nɨma sakwat nɨmba Kraist kat kai walɨgandi. Ndina vak vɨlaa kɨpmana vat ngɨlɨgiya njɨmbla tamba ngwaya waa yelavɨtɨgangwuk.

Kraist kat kai walɨga nɨmba tat nɨnagwinala yetɨndi. Nɨna mbaapma nɨmba ana ndi. Kwo nɨmba ndi. Nɨna mbaapma nɨmba tɨga yinjan nɨn kat ana kagalgedi. Nɨn kat kwagalanjangat vɨlaa nɨna mbaapma nɨmba ana ndi waa wɨnɨn.
Gwuk kapma vat tɨga nɨmba ngwuk. Godna waagan ngwuk kat taviga apma maawut kwindɨ.
Ngwuk Godna vak ana vɨga lɨgangwuk waa ana waigowun. Vɨga lɨgangwuk. Godna vak woseka waa vak ana ndɨ waa vɨga lɨgangwuk. Wungi kat tɨga ngwuk kat pɨlɨwutɨgowun.
Jisas God waa nyan ana ndɨ Kraist ana ndɨ waa walɨga nyan ndɨ woseka walɨga nyana. Ndɨ Kraist kat kai walɨga nyana. Godnogwi ndɨna nyan kat kai walɨga nyana.
Jisas God waa nyan ana ndɨ waa kɨta nyan wandeyanwan nyan Godnonala kɨta vak ana yetɨlɨgandɨ. Jisas God waa nyana waa kɨta nyan wandeyan wan nyan Godnonala kɨta vat yetɨlɨgandɨ.
Tak wukngwa apma nyaangɨt ngwutna maawupmba taaga. Wan apma nyaangɨt ngwula maawupmba lɨndeyan Godnogwi ndɨna nyanonala kɨta vat yetɨgiyangwuk.
Tak God nɨn kat wandɨ. Njɨmbla njɨmbla apma vat yetɨngweya vak gwuk kat kwigiyowun waa wandɨ God.
Nat nɨmba ngwutna maawuk kat kavle vat yivat wandi. Ngwutna maawut kwunapmak kat kdinai yetɨga vak ke vɨga waa ngwuk kat pɨlɨwutɨgowun.

God dɨna waagan gwuk kat kwindɨ, tavilaa ngwula maawupmba lɨgandɨ. Wun manda kat ngwula maawuk kat kwunapmak pɨlɨwutɨgowun. Godna waagan ngwula maawuk kat kwunaka gwuk kat apmavat aywaa sɨmagalɨgandɨ. Ngwuk kat sɨmagalɨnda vak woseka wa vak ana ndɨ. Savagu lɨga vatna. Ngwuk kat sɨmaganda vapmba ndɨnogwinala kɨta vat yetɨ. Kɨta vat yetɨngweyan yaiga njɨmblamba ngwutna mbangɨ wup ana yigiyandɨ. Ndɨ kat vɨga an vakiyangwuk.
Jisas Kraist apma vat mɨna yetɨlɨndɨ. Vɨga wutɨgangwuk. Kɨta nyan apma vat yetɨlɨga ntyan tɨndeyan Jisas Kraist njanga nyanat tɨgandɨ waa vɨga wutɨgangwuk.
